descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you independent and self-driven? Do you have sharp analytic skills? We’re looking for someone like that who can:
•evaluate counterparty credit risk of hedge funds and family offices based on solid understanding of the counterparty's risk profile, business environment, exposure, and financial performance as well as a number of other quantitative and qualitative measures of counterparty’ credit worthiness (This includes client due diligence via client visit or conference call)
• •prepare counterparty reviews/transactional credit proposals drawing conclusions relating to credit assessment, risk appetite, exposure drivers and business prospects
• •approve new trades or to make recommendations to higher authority levels within Credit
• •perform ad hoc credit risk analysis and portfolio deep dive when necessary.
• •participate in portfolio reviews to identify risk developments or concentrations
• •exercise judgment and escalate decisions of high-risk trades to higher authority levels, as needed
• •lead trading documentation negotiation including ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage and Repo Agreements
